title: 87. Binary Search

examples.explanation: Target 9 is found at index 4 in the sorted array.
Target 2 is not present in the array.
Target 5 is found at index 0 in the sorted array.

hints: Compare target with the middle element and discard the half that cannot contain it.
Track an inclusive search interval with left <= right.
Compute the midpoint as left + (right - left) / 2.
